Alex — thanks for sending party data. I've completed an initial pass and attached a proposed redline (Redwood_MSARedline_Markus_v1.docx). High-level items we intend to mark:
- Exhibit A: propose 90-day default retention for logs, 30-day for request payloads; open to negotiating specific retention windows for different data classes.
- Security appendix: we'll provide SOC2 Type II evidence and a standard security addendum; need to confirm encryption KMS approach for Nebula.
- Indemnity / limitation: limited liability cap tied to the Order Form fees; we will propose changes consistent with our template.
- Payment terms: our standard is Net 30; can escalate Net 45/60 to commercial if revenue justifies.

Two small asks for your team: can Dana Holt and legal counsel be available for a 30-min call to walk the redlines? Also, if Nebula requires data residency in a specific region, flag that now — it will affect hosting options.

I'll send a consolidated tracked-redline back to Alex within 48 hours.
